title: Missile strike hits Black Sea Fleet headquarters in Sevastopol
body:
On 22 September 2023 a Ukrainian missile strike hit the headquarters of Russia's Black Sea Fleet in Sevastopol, in Russian-occupied Crimea, according to reporting by the Kyiv Independent. The Russian Defence Ministry said the strike damaged the headquarters building and that Russian air defences shot down five missiles over Sevastopol. It said earlier that its forces had downed a Ukrainian guided missile and two drones over Crimea's west coast at about 10:30 a.m. Moscow time.

Mikhail Razvozhaev, head of the Russian occupation administration in Sevastopol, first reported the strike. He said missile debris had fallen near a theatre by Sevastopol Bay. Local Telegram channels reported that a smoke screen was deployed over the bay and that authorities suspended sea transport and blocked traffic on the Crimean Bridge.

Several hours later Ukraine's Strategic Communications Directorate confirmed the missile strike without giving further details. Air Force commander Mykola Oleshchuk posted a video of the aftermath and thanked Ukrainian pilots.

The Russian Defence Ministry said one serviceman was missing. Razvozhaev said there was no damage to civilian infrastructure and no civilian casualties, and firefighters were still working to put out the fire at the headquarters. The Kyiv Independent said it could not verify any of these claims.
